messages:
Marin (People Ops): Quick PSA — Samira's last week at Redwood is next Friday, and it's also her birthday on Thursday. We'd love to do a small hybrid send-off + birthday snack. Vote below and volunteer for one task (pick snack + packer/signer):
1) Mini donut tower in-office + group card
2) Tea & biscotti care packages for remote folks + Zoom toast
3) Charcuterie box (vegetarian-friendly) + singalong at lunch
Reply 1/2/3 and add your volunteer role. Signup: https://tiny.redwood/samira-sendoff. @here

Samira: omg no big speeches pls, crying guaranteed :sob: I'll try to keep it low-key but love you all already <3

Eli: 2  remote here, happy to help pack and address care packages. Also can chip in $15 for postage.

Jo: 1  donuts! I can pick them up and label vegan options.

Nina: 3  charcuterie sounds fab. I can organize the platter and bring a portable speaker for background music.

Marin (People Ops): Amazing. Volunteers so far: Jo (donuts pickup), Eli (pack+postage), Nina (charcuterie+music). Need 1 person to handle the card sign-off and one to run the Zoom toast at 4:30pm PT on Thu.

PeopleOpsBot: Event draft created "Samira send-off + bday"  May 9  4:30pm PT  Zoom link attached  RSVP: 7

Samira: you guys are too sweet. I promise not to cry during the toast, no promises after :laughing:

Eli: I'll take the card sign-off task. Everyone, drop a quick line in the doc with your message and I'll print it.

Jo: I'll do pickup + napkins. Any allergies? Samira is allergic to shellfish FYI.

Marin (People Ops): Noted about shellfish. Final plan: hybrid snacks (in-office donuts + charcuterie), care packages to remotes who sign up, card printing, and a 5-min Zoom toast. Please add your message for the card in the signup doc by Wednesday EOD and DM any short clips for a farewell montage. Thanks team :confetti_ball:
